settings.text: Be the first to know when we launch.

Ar Raheequl Makhtoom (Arabic for ‘the sealed nectar’) represents a multigenerational and extended farming family with saffron, almond and walnut as the main crops. With the new generation carrying the family occupation forward equipped with the appropriate skills required in the internet age, the time to engage with the customers directly has finally been perceived. We belong to the famous valley of Kashmir known for the topography ideal for the cultivation of the world’s best saffron (the costliest spice too!). The Almond and Walnut native to the valley are second to none in the world in their categories. We as a family have pledged to serve our customers with genuine produce from the valley which many people across the globe yearn for. The feedback and appreciation from our customers give us light and energy to carry forward the legacy which our forefathers have left for us.

Spread the word among your near and dear, our store (almakhtoom) will be live soon!
